new_learnings.text: Entry regime hard-block correctly prevented any new positions today: breadth 0.53:1, 0/3 major indices green, f10=76. In V1 this might have forced a 'small buy' — V2 discipline returns empty new_positions[] as designed.
new_learnings.mechanism: The hard-block gate (breadth ≥1.5:1, ≥2 indices green, f10<30) acts as a circuit breaker preventing entries during panic conditions where even good stocks get dragged down.

new_learnings.text: Defensive rotation validated Rule 1 (sector-first): 养殖业+4.44% and 煤炭+4.26% led while 光学光电子-5.67% sank. Even the best individual candidates in cold sectors (奥来德 +492% earnings growth, 水晶光电 行业龙头) are un-buyable — sector gravity always wins.
new_learnings.mechanism: When institutional money rotates sectors, individual stock fundamentals become secondary to sector flows. A -5.67% sector headwind overwhelms even +492% earnings growth.

new_learnings.text: US碳酸锂战略收储 catalyst is insulating 融捷股份 (+3.07%) from the broad sell-off, validating thesis-driven positions during weak tapes. Fresh policy catalysts can temporarily decouple a stock from sector/ market gravity.
new_learnings.mechanism: Government strategic reserve announcements create a policy floor that changes supply/demand expectations independently of market risk appetite.

new_learnings.text: MA-distance rule (h027) continues filtering chase-risk: 隆达股份(dist_ma5=+10.2%), 申菱环境(dist_ma5=+9.1%/ma10=+12.3%/ma20=+13.3%), 凯莱英(dist_ma10=+13.1%) all fail despite strong fundamentals. Rule is preventing entries at extended prices.
new_learnings.mechanism: Stocks that spike far above short-term MAs have high mean-reversion probability. The 6%/8%/12% thresholds on MA5/MA10/MA20 catch these before mean reversion inflicts -5%+ damage.
